purpose: Auditable status/license/namespace/governance registry supporting R-002. This is research evidence, not a production ontology lock format.

candidates.name: SKOS
candidates.license: W3C specification/document terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.deprecation_policy: W3C namespace/specification governance; pin tested Recommendation/snapshot
candidates.offline: downloadable specification and RDF vocabulary; cache pinned snapshot
candidates.scope: concept schemes and SKOS publication mapping relations
candidates.overlap: provides publication mapping relations for genuine SKOS concepts; TFont owns the formalism-neutral runtime mapping assessment, while OWL/RDFS targets retain their own formalism

candidates.name: PROV-O
candidates.license: W3C specification/document terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.deprecation_policy: W3C namespace/specification governance; pin tested Recommendation/snapshot
candidates.overlap: replaces need for TFont-specific generic provenance vocabulary

candidates.name: Web Annotation Vocabulary
candidates.license: W3C specification/document terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.deprecation_policy: W3C namespace/specification governance; pin tested Recommendation/snapshot
candidates.overlap: preferred portable targeting layer over adopting POWLA as generic runtime structure

candidates.name: SHACL
candidates.license: W3C specification/document terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.maintenance: 1.0 stable; 1.2 was draft at research date
candidates.deprecation_policy: keep 1.0 validation baseline until later version is final and separately reviewed
candidates.overlap: tooling standard, not a humanities ontology

candidates.name: Ontologies of Linguistic Annotation
candidates.license: CC BY 3.0 for RDF/OWL unless a component states otherwise; code separately Apache-licensed
candidates.deprecation_policy: stable PURLs but no single semver contract; pin source revision/content digest
candidates.offline: Git repository contains machine-readable OWL; cache exact commit
candidates.scope: linguistic annotation categories and reference models
candidates.overlap: complements LexInfo; use definition-fit rather than duplicate targets

candidates.name: OntoLex-Lemon core
candidates.license: W3C Community Group report/specification terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.redistribution: usable as published CG specification/vocabulary; record CG/FSA status rather than describing it as a W3C Recommendation
candidates.maintenance: community remains active; core 1.1 work was ongoing in 2026
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin 2016 Final Report for POC; later core revisions require explicit upgrade
candidates.scope: lexical entries, forms, senses/concepts and decomposition
candidates.overlap: lexical layer complementary to OLiA/LexInfo

candidates.name: OntoLex VarTrans
candidates.status: published module of OntoLex 2016 Final Report family
candidates.license: W3C Community Group report/specification terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin tested published module snapshot
candidates.overlap: does not turn arbitrary bilingual glosses into translation assertions

candidates.name: OntoLex Lexicog
candidates.license: W3C Community Group report/specification terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.maintenance: published module in active OntoLex ecosystem
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin 2019 final snapshot
candidates.overlap: optional extension of OntoLex core rather than universal corpus dependency

candidates.name: LexInfo
candidates.license: Apache-2.0
candidates.deprecation_policy: versioned namespace; pin 3.0 artifact and source revision
candidates.overlap: complements OLiA; avoid redundant targets where definitions differ

candidates.name: OntoLex Morph
candidates.license: W3C Community Group draft/specification terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.redistribution: draft materials are accessible, but TFont does not make them normative
candidates.deprecation_policy: not applicable as supported release; re-evaluate after final CG publication
candidates.offline: Git repository and Turtle ontology available
candidates.overlap: could improve future morphological modelling but current draft status blocks support tier

candidates.name: OntoLex FrAC
candidates.license: W3C Community Group draft/specification terms; preserve applicable notices
candidates.redistribution: draft materials are accessible, but TFont does not make them normative
candidates.deprecation_policy: re-evaluate after final CG publication
candidates.offline: Git repository and generated ontology available
candidates.overlap: potential future attestation profile; not needed for initial runtime contract

candidates.name: CIDOC CRM
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0
candidates.maintenance: active; later 7.x documents including 7.4 were draft at research date
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin 7.1.3 official; drafts require separate opt-in/review
candidates.offline: official RDFS/OWL and documentation releases downloadable
candidates.scope: cultural-heritage entities, events, identifiers, places and physical objects
candidates.overlap: heritage backbone; not a replacement for linguistic/lexical ontologies

candidates.name: CRMtex
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 (CIDOC CRM family publication/model terms)
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin stable 2.0 release; upgrade only after profile review
candidates.scope: written/inscribed textual entities and text-bearing objects
candidates.overlap: specializes CIDOC CRM for textual/epigraphic domain

candidates.name: LRMoo
candidates.authority: IFLA LRMoo Working Group + CIDOC CRM SIG
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin official 1.1.1; prefer over superseded FRBRoo for new mappings
candidates.offline: official specification and machine-readable ontology downloadable
candidates.overlap: bibliographic specialization interoperable with CIDOC CRM

candidates.name: CRMinf
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 (CIDOC CRM family publication/model terms)
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin stable release and review migrations
candidates.overlap: optional detailed evidence model beyond simple TFont mapping-confidence metadata

candidates.name: CRMarchaeo
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 (CIDOC CRM family publication/model terms)
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin stable release
candidates.overlap: optional specialization; not required by object/catalogue metadata alone

candidates.name: CRMsci
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 (CIDOC CRM family publication/model terms)
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin stable release
candidates.overlap: optional for future scientific/material-analysis modules

candidates.name: Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus
candidates.version_or_date: download center checked 2026-09-05; June 2026 data update context
candidates.license: ODC-By 1.0
candidates.redistribution: allowed with attribution subject to ODC-By
candidates.deprecation_policy: record term URI plus validated vocabulary snapshot/date; do not assume a term's current state from live endpoint
candidates.offline: downloadable vocabulary data; cache only required snapshot/subset when practical
candidates.scope: materials, object/work types, techniques, roles, cultures
candidates.overlap: external term vocabulary complementary to CIDOC CRM classes/relations

candidates.name: PeriodO
candidates.license: CC0/public-domain dedication
candidates.redistribution: unrestricted subject to source citation best practice
candidates.deprecation_policy: pin period identifier plus dataset snapshot/revision used for validation
candidates.offline: JSON-LD/Turtle dataset exports and stable permalinks available
candidates.overlap: external controlled vocabulary rather than general time ontology

candidates.name: POWLA
candidates.version_or_date: project history predates current TFont stack; public project last-update metadata 2020
candidates.namespace: historical POWLA RDF/OWL namespace; must be snapshot-pinned if used for alignment
candidates.license: historical project listings use CC Attribution and LGPLv3 for different materials; treat as mixed project licensing
candidates.redistribution: reference only; do not make a new normative dependency without component-specific license review
candidates.deprecation_policy: no TFont support lifecycle; reference fixed historical source only
candidates.scope: generic RDF representation of linguistic annotation graphs
candidates.overlap: native TF graph + Web Annotation + OLiA cover the required roles with stronger current governance

candidates.name: Sharing Ancient Wisdoms ontology
candidates.license: reusable ontology license not established from authoritative distribution inspected
candidates.redistribution: reference only until reusable ontology rights are established and pinned
candidates.maintenance: historical project ontology; limited current evolution
candidates.deprecation_policy: reference fixed version only
candidates.offline: ontology can be downloaded/cached for reference; redistribution rights require separate authoritative evidence
candidates.overlap: useful prior art; older FRBRoo dependency and unresolved reusable ontology licensing argue against normative adoption

candidates.name: Critical Apparatus Ontology
candidates.license: CC BY 3.0 declared inside ontology
candidates.deprecation_policy: no mature release/deprecation lifecycle observed; pin exact ontology snapshot
candidates.scope: critical apparatus variation units, readings and philological argumentation
candidates.overlap: closest apparatus prior art; keep apparatus domain concepts native/profile-local until a second independent corpus establishes the recurring semantic gap or mapping infrastructure requires a shared term
